items.body:
As the groups come to a close, many of you will be wondering what's next in the cup! Here is a reminder.

# Progression paths

After all group games are played, progression to the next stages will be determined as follows:
* 1st position skips playoff stage, goes directly into Quarter Finals of the last stage.
* Best 2nd position of the 3 groups, skips playoff stage, goes directly into Quarter Finals of the last stage.
* Other 2nd positions, skips playoff stage, goes directly into the last stage (pre Quarter Finals).
* 3rd, 4th, 5th & 6th positions proceed to the playoff stage.

## Playoff Stage

[Illustration here](https://evidence.memenook.com/seafhttp/f/79381e546d7f41fbb71f/?op=view)

**Monday 26th October - Sunday 7th November** (14 days)

**Round 1 matches must be played early on, to ensure the other matches are not bottlencked**

The Playoff Stage uses a modified Swiss style qualification format.

Teams are assigned an initial win-loss record based on their Group Stage placement:
* 3rd place teams: start in the 1-0 position.
* 4th and 5th place teams: start in the 0-0 position.
* 6th place teams: start in the 0-1 position.

A team:
* Qualifies for Finals Stage after its second win.
* Is eliminated after its second loss.

Your match-ups within a given bracket will be calculated dynamically, to avoid repeat match-ups wherever possible.

* Playoff Matches = BO5 maps, BO3 rounds per map
  * Time Limit = 8 minutes with overtime, no ties

## Finals Stage

[Illustration here](https://evidence.memenook.com/seafhttp/f/84206cdbf2434f629069/?op=view)

**Monday 8th - Sunday 22nd November** (14 days)

**GRAND FINAL = Sunday 22nd November**

This is a single elimination bracket.

The Pre-Quarter Finals will be populated by the 6 teams that  progressed via the playoffs + the 2 "worst" 2nd place teams from the group stage. The 2 teams that came directly from group stage will have easier opponents (from round 3 of playoffs)

The Quarter Finals will be populated by the 3 1st place teams from the group stage, the "best" 2nd place team from the group stage, and the 4 winners from the Pre-Quarter Finals.

* Finals Matches = BO5 maps, BO5 rounds per map
  * Time Limit = 8 minutes with overtime, no ties

# Rule Changes

* Lower skilled teams that could only play the 9 easier maps in the group-stage, will now have the choice to add-in the 4 harder maps. If any lower skilled team chooses not to do this in a match, then those 4 harder maps are VETO'd

* Overtime now enabled, no round ties possible any more.

items.body:
Play-offs are drawn and can be seen under the event on UTBT.net (Bracket > Playoff Stage)
# Teams that move directly into the Quarter Finals

- 2 guys 1 cap (soupy & kleps)
- Niagra Fools (NinThomas & gxls)
- BAD BOYS (Dylanbroo & Bakica)
- Puzzle Masters (Xclusive & Arturek)

# Teams that move directly into the Pre-Quarter Finals

- Sandbagging (Bun & OwYeaW)
- Phalanx (PatriK & GiorgiO)

[Illustration here](https://evidence.memenook.com/seafhttp/f/545ac1fa6d9343658fb6/?op=view)

The three 1st place finishers all move directly into the quarter finals.

Puzzle Masters (Xclusive & Arturek) were the best 2nd place finisher in the group stage, and so also manage to secure their place in the quarter finals.

The remaining two 2nd place finishers secure their place in the pre-quarter finals.

# But for now... on to the play-offs!
**All other teams move into the play-offs**

[Illustration here](https://evidence.memenook.com/seafhttp/f/919537f897b649fca22f/?op=view)

**Monday 26th October - Sunday 7th November** (14 days)

The Playoff Stage uses a modified Swiss style qualification format.

## Play-offs - Round 1 ... 0-0

**Round 1 matches must be played early on, to ensure the other matches are not bottle-necked**

- Team Trials (Vernon & Bugatti) vs Los Primos (Nettlez & TekuMiles)
- Bunny Hunters (Alexxeh & Slati) vs Buddy System (Riddick & Some_Dude)
- Div4 (tOmy` & Humak) vs KNRK (twistytank & Rob-Bot)

The winners of these 3 matches will move up into the 1-0 segment of the play-offs.

The losers of these 3 matches will move down into the 0-1 segment of the play-offs.

## Play-offs - Round 2 ... 1-0 & 0-1

The 3rd place finishers await the winning teams from Round 1 in the 1-0 segment.

The 6th place finishers await the losing teams from Round 1 in the 0-1 segment.

## Play-offs - Round 3 ... 1-1

Teams that have not already qualified or been eliminated will have one more chance to win a match in Round 3.
